user.title: Set up Light Wrapper
user.description: Creates the “Global settings” and “Light groups” entries. Afterwards, add light groups on the “Light groups” entry via “Add light group”.

abort.already_configured: Light Wrapper is already set up. Add light groups on the “Light groups” entry via “Add light group”.

init.title: Edit global settings
init.description: These transitions apply to all light groups that do not set their own. They are only used when the call does not specify a transition.

data_description.default_transition_on: Used when turning on without a transition; only sent to lights that support transitions.
data_description.default_transition_off: Used when turning off without a transition; only sent to lights that support transitions.

user.title: Add light group
user.description: Combines several lights into one light entity. Optional defaults are used when the light is turned on without brightness or color.

data_description.hide_members: Hides the group's lights in the UI (like group helpers). They are shown again when this is turned off, when a light is removed from the group or when the group is deleted. Lights you hid yourself stay hidden.
